value.rationale: Because prior work proves there is a single projective-equivalence class in this extremal free case, its PGL3 stabilizer is the canonical isotropy datum of that moduli point rather than an arbitrary coordinate statistic. Determining it exactly distinguishes coarse uniqueness from stack-level rigidity and identifies how the three singularity types descend under symmetry. The result is complete for this natural invariant and is not a parameter slice or recomputation of the published freeness certificate.
